title: Gadget has fan-in at most two
statement: For every natural number $m$ and every Boolean function $f$ on assignments to $m$ variables, the gadget constructed from $f$ is well formed and every gate in it has at most two inputs.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps assignments of $m$ Boolean variables to a Boolean value
